Adding technical specifics from the ops side. Inline: 

- Bridge endpoints: Redwood will provide two TLS endpoints (primary + hot-standby). Sophie, please confirm ACME's DMZ IP ranges so we can set up mutual TLS if needed.
- Network/Carrier: Riley (VenueHub) listed the on-site fiber handoff at Patch 12-B. I will schedule a site walk with Riley on 5/24 at 11:00 PT to verify SFP types and power feeds.
- RTP/ports: prefer RTP ports 10000-10100 UDP. If venue NAT prevents direct ports, we'll use TURN with a static outbound IP set (we'll provide that IP).
- Simulcast encoder: we'll run an H.264 fMP4 output to the bridge and also multicast locally for the breakout rooms. Need confirmation that the venue switch supports IGMP snooping.
- Fallback plan: if primary fiber is degraded we will failover to bonded cellular (two carriers) and the simulcast will reduce to 720p to preserve latency.

I can lead the dry-run on 6/12 at 11:00 PT if that works for the team.
